Method of Attack: Exploitation of Shellshock (CVE-2014-6271) vulnerability to take over QNAP NAS devices
Patching infected device to prevent further exploitation
Downloading and execution of IRC bot
Click fraud via fraudulent advertisement visits
Attack Vector: Remote code execution via Shellshock vulnerability on port 80
Indicators of Compromise: Use of 'Gaspolo' nickname in botnet infrastructure
Botnet spread to over 2,500 QNAP NAS devices across 70 countries
